paragraphs.context: where a man was hung for murder
paragraphs.mainIdea: The song is not a simple love song. The dead man in the tree wants the woman he loves to die with him.
paragraphs.simple: She and her father stopped the song. After he died, it kept coming back to her. When she was older, she understood the words. At the start it sounds like a boy asking a girl to meet him at night. The place is not normal. It is a tree where a man was killed because he killed three people. The girl he loved may have helped him, or the people in power were going to hurt her anyway. His dead body calls to her to run. That is not normal. In the third part it gets worse. The one the song comes from is the dead man. He is still in the tree. He told her to run, but he still asks if she is coming. The line about running so they could both be free is the hard part. At first it sounds like he wants her to run to a safe place. Then you see he may want her to run to him, and to death. In the last part that is clear. He wants her dead next to him in the tree.
